_comment: Test-environment spec for the dev WHMCS. skeleton.php ensures everything here exists (create-if-missing, never destructive). Recorded from the live dev box on 2026-07-19.

products.name: Reseller - One-Month Premium Code
products._moduleSettings: vpnhoodstore module settings recorded from the hand-made dev product #10 on 2026-07-20. configoption4 = Token Delivery Method (0 = Normal, 1 = CSV), configoption5 = Access Token Group — the group moved from slot 4 to 5 when the delivery-method field was added.

products.name: Reseller - One-Month Premium Code (Subscription)
products._moduleSettings: vpnhoodstore module settings recorded from the hand-made dev product #11 on 2026-07-20. configoption4 = Token Delivery Method (0 = Normal, 1 = CSV), configoption5 = Access Token Group — the group moved from slot 4 to 5 when the delivery-method field was added.

addons._comment: Activation state + config recorded from the admin-saved setup of 2026-07-19. 'version' is deliberately NOT listed: WHMCS owns that row, and the module version now changes on every release (see VERSION + scripts/set-version.sh), so pinning it here would make skeleton.php rewrite it back on every run.

reseller._groupidNote: vpnhoodconfig AllowedClientGroups=1 — resellers must be in this client group to see the restricted reseller store
reseller._role: The partner/reseller funding client. Hub partner spend draws from this client's native WHMCS credit.

partner.name: Test Reseller
partner._credentials: api key/secret live in <Vh root>/.user/account-dev.vpnhood.com/secrets.json (partnerApiKey / partnerApiSecret), passed to skeleton.php via env
